test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a hostel, 40 students are there. If 5 new students join, then the expenses of the mess will increase by ₹ 48 per day while the average expenditure per student will diminish by ₹ 2. What was the original expenditure of the mess?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total students = 40 + 5 = 45

Let the average expenditure be Rs "a".

New expenditure of the mess = 40a + 48

According to the question-

⇒ 40a + 48over45 - a = -2

⇒ 40a + 48 - 45a = -2 × 45

⇒ 48 - 5a = -90

⇒ 48 + 90 = 5a

⇒ a = 138over5 = Rs 27.6

∴ Original expenditure of the mess = Rs 27.6 × 40 = Rs 1,104

**The original expenditure of the mess is Rs 1,104.**
